text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Some time after the Arima Kinen.
During a meeting with Fenomeno—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Squeeeak...)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Whenever something completely absurd happens,
she's almost always behind it.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —Gold Ship-san!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Do NOT break in through the window!
If you're coming in, use the door!!
It is extremely dangerous!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You idiot!
If you do that, Mame-chin's gonna notice us, won't he?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I've already noticed, though?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship is as unconventional as ever.
Over these past three years, Fenomeno wonders
just how many times she has crossed paths with her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Starting with the Satsuki Sho, where she ran as if beckoned by fate, followed that same year by the Japan Derby and the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even moving up to the Senior Year, there's the Tenno Sho (Spring), the Takarazuka Kinen, the Japan Cup, the Arima Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Btw~.
Isn't Mame-chin totally cheating?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Unfair?
What is, sir?
choice_data_list: You did keep beating Gold Ship, after all.
After all, you kept winning against Gold Ship.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...! That is true.
Her directing feelings of jealousy toward me is only natural for a rival.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Golshi-san. I accept those feelings.
As a declaration of war from you to me, saying,
'I will surpass you without fail'—"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: What're you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Damn straight!
I'm gonna...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
She calls her Trainer by a nickname, but won't
let them call her one back...!
I can't stand that kind of attitude!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Mame-chin!
Try calling out to Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Ngh!? Boss!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Try calling out to Mame-chin!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: That should be Mame-chin, dammit...!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...To begin with, the title 'Boss'
is something I use as a term of utmost respect."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"In contrast, forcing the Boss to call me by a nickname
would actually be disrespectful, sir!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Is it 'cause you and the Boss ain't close enough for him to give you a nickname?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: The Boss and I are good pals, though!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Then, Trainer!
Call them over right away!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Please wait a moment, Boss...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Wh-What is this feeling...!
She is my boss! My boss, I tell you...!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Right, Boss was just copying
what Golshi-san calls me. It sounds friendly,
like a classmate, but it's not like—)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, more! Pour on the extra bonito flakes!
Mame-chin still hasn't answered yet!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Wait up! Boss! Golshi-san!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Boss-san?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Haaah—!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Wh-What have I done...!
Damn it, what should I do!?
My thoughts are getting all fuzzy—!!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: H-Hey! I told you to stop—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Boss, please forgive me...
Any further would be... too dangerous...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Boss, we must not let our relationship be taken lightly!
We are a Trainer and an Umamusume in our contract! We must maintain proper boundaries!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...Ghh, Golshi-san!
How could you do such a thing--unforgivable!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Get away from Mame-chin and win 1,000,000 Golshi Yen!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—...gh, that makes even less sense!
Golshiiiiiii-saaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...For now, I decided to keep calling Fenomeno the same way as before.
